content: Having a blast in Hokitika looking for greenstone. I don't think we've found any yet. Only a lot of serpentine. It's still been lots of fun. The kids are getting along really well with the other kids here. I'm enjoying the cultural side too even though I'm totally clueless. Am a bit worried about Kate's driving but.. whatever. Learning experience for her too. I really should have taken the time off work though. Trying to work here has been an absolute mission.
